---------------------
--Create View Subcate
---------------------
CREATE VIEW gold.Subcategories
AS
    SELECT
*
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
                BULK 'https://anshadfstorage.blob.core.windows.net/bronze/AdventureWorks_Product_Subcategories/',
                FORMAT = 'CSV',
                PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
                HEADER_ROW = TRUE
    )as query1
